thread:
lina: Opening a small PR to improve the Private installer "networking + migration" section. Main goals: add a Node.js SDK example for KMS with client certs, clarify a canary path for migrating from cloud KMS to on-prem HSM, and include a compact preflight. Need quick review.

frank: sounds good. Can you paste the Node.js snippet you'll add? Ops teams file most tickets for Node users.

lina: Node snippet added to the PR comments: ```js
const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood.PrivateClient({
  kmsEndpoint: 'https://kms.internal:8443',
  clientCert: '/etc/ssl/client.crt',
  clientKey: '/etc/ssl/client.key',
  caCert: '/etc/ssl/ca.crt'
});
await client.healthcheck();
```

tomas: nice. For migration add a 3-step canary path: 1) enable passthrough on one node; 2) verify sign/verify with HSM using healthcheck; 3) cordon/drain and roll. Spell out drain/cordon commands.

lina: done. Added explicit commands in PR: ```sh
kubectl cordon node/canary-0
kubectl drain node/canary-0 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
kubectl uncordon node/canary-0
```

frank: also include a minimal preflight script that checks ip_forward, route to HSM, NAT rules and clock:

lina: short preflight added: ```sh
sysctl -n net.ipv4.ip_forward || echo "ERROR: ip_forward disabled"
ip route get 172.31.11.5 || echo "WARN: no route to HSM"
iptables -t nat -S | grep -E "MASQUERADE|RETURN" || true
date -u && timedatectl show -p NTPSynchronized || echo "WARN: clock unsynced"
```

frank: can you also show an nftables example for exempting HSM subnet from masq? Some customers use nft.

lina: added nft example: ```nft
table ip nat {
  chain postrouting { type nat hook postrouting priority 100; ip saddr 10.0.0.0/16 ip daddr 172.31.11.0/24 accept; oifname \"eth0\" masquerade }
}
```

tomas: nit: change "preserve src" to "preserve source IP for HSM audit logs". Also the HSM PKCS#11 link in the docs is stale; use /integrations/hsm/pkcs11/.

docs-bot: automated suggestion applied: replaced "/hsm-plugin/" with "/integrations/hsm/pkcs11/" in PR #2294.

lina: updated wording and will attach a tiny netns test script (curl with client cert) to PR. Merging after docs-bot linkcheck green. Thanks! :shipit:
